Chapter 7053: Hook

Chapter 7053: Hook

Zhao Dachui, the feared existence, had the ability to devour worlds and even primordial immortals. Thus, everyone ran at the sight of this black hole.

“Wait, there is something different about the core.” Heaven’s Equal noticed something amiss.

He had seen the black hole before - the core was nothing but darkness. However, this one had tribulations instead.

Those in the Dusk Realm were affected, feeling as if they were turning into particles being sucked into the singularity. The process couldn’t be reversed since Zhao Dachui was at the celestial level.

They screamed in horror. Only primordial immortals maintained stability but it was only a matter of time.

“Have to trust Li Qiye.” Overlords and immortals could only pray for Li Qiye’s victory.

Meanwhile, those in Heavenrealm observed the black hole twisting and absorbing their worlds’ affinities.

“Someone is trying to devour Heavenrealm?” Immortals everywhere worried.

Inside Dusk Realm, Heaven’s Equal saw the singularity moving closer to Li Qiye, subjecting him to the full force of the black hole.

“It’s over...” They didn’t think he would be able to break the black hole and reverse the disintegration.

“Boom!” A flash suddenly overcame the darkness. It came from a hook by Li Qiye.

The black hole suddenly shattered, revealing Zhao Dachui’s true body. Next, it crumbled into particles.

Affected immortals and all living beings had their life forces and powers returned to them. They dropped to the ground, albeit with joy since everything returned to normalcy.

They became speechless since Zhao Dachui’s great technique was nullified by a single hook. Moreover, his fortified body shattered into particles as well - a type of karmic retribution.

“This hook is comparable to the enforcer’s slash...” One immortal commented.

Just when everyone thought this was the end, Zhao Dachui’s particles flashed with lightning and came together.

“What’s going on?” They saw the massive figure once more.

However, he couldn’t maintain his form and collapsed into the tribulation liquid again.

“Can’t reform.” Heaven’s Equal murmured.

Sure enough, Zhao Dachui tried several more times to no avail. Thus, the waves began surging through the passage out of Dusk Realm.
